newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tabcorp reaches deal with Sky TV.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tabcorp reaches deal with Sky TV.

text.p: Tabcorp Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had reached agreement with Sky Television to resume televised racing to betting agencies throughout Victoria.
Tabcorp said it would pay an annual fee of A$6 million to Sky with an annual increase of six percent for a period of six years.

"TAB agents throughout Victoria have been without the racing picture since October 1, 1996 when SKY rejected TABCORP's offer of an increase from A$10,000 per agency to A$24,000 per agency for provision of the racing picture," Tabcorp said.

"The support of the (Victorian) Premier, Mr Jeff Kennett, has been integral to the re-establishment of the SKY service and TABCORP is grateful for his involvement," Tabcorp managing director Ross Wilson said.
"We are also pleased with the significant financial support that the Victorian racing industry has provided," he said.

The Victorian Racing Club, which runs some of Australia's best known races, said last week that it had offered to pay half of the fee demanded by Sky, a joint venture between Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd and Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd. --Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
